text_block_list.text:
On this day, I visited Chukyo Racecourse 
with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...That was quite delightful, wasn't it? 
The Pre-Fi show, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! Your cheers reached 
deep into my heart!

text_block_list.name: Prifight
text_block_list.text:
Channeling the energy of the earth into 
power! Shine brighter than anyone else! 
Princess Rising!

text_block_list.name: Dark Princess
text_block_list.text: U-Ugyaaaaaaaaaah desu waaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
PriFie really was wonderful. Tomboyish, 
cool, and cute. With elegance, yet true to 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"And here I thought I was going to become 
a princess like that too."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just selfish, only capable of 
hurting others.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Hey, looks like it's starting! The paddock 
for the Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Really?! That first-class young lady is 
running too, right? Hehe, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Everyone, the first-rate 
Umamusume King Halo has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Kingー!! Did you come to claim the 
throne this year tooー!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it about time your era came to an 
end? How long are you planning to cling to 
your active career~?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? How could they say such awful 
things to King-san!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Unforgivable! I shall go and punish them! 
Verbal abuse like "bad-mouthers" is—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Attention!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I hope you all haven't gotten the wrong 
impression.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am the only one who can decide what I 
will do. It has nothing to do with any of 
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You may direct whatever words you wish at 
me. Feel free to perceive me however you 
please.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now, I shall grant all of you the 
privilege of witnessing it. —The way I run 
my own path, true to myself.

And the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, in which 
King Halo was running, got underway. The 
result was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
King Halo takes 1st place! Sweeping past 
the competition in one fell swoop, an 
exquisite 1st place finish!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Did you witness King's graceful 
and brilliant running?!

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a first-rate Umamusume~! 
Are you aiming to sweep the Spring-Autumn 
Sprint double this year too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Why not retire while you're still on a 
high note? Stop throwing tantrums for your 
own ego. Ahh, I feel so bad for the 
younger ones.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Me, selfish?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't make me laugh. I simply walked 
my own path in my own way.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Whether an action is selfish or genuinely 
true to myself... I am the only one who 
has the right to judge that.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list:
…Being selfish and being true to yourself 
are two different things.

text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to hurt anyone is an admirable 
sentiment. However, if you strive to stay 
true to your own path, you will inevitably 
end up hurting someone along the way.

—Just as the rise of a victor creates the 
defeated. Just as one person's justice is 
not the justice of all.

Whether that action was purely selfish, or 
simply being true to myself.
choice_data_list: You're the one who has to decide that.

You're the one who has to decide that for 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Myself.

—That night, in front of the student 
dorms.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...You were there for today's 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, weren't you, 
Kawakami-san?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-You noticed!? King-san!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, from the paddock. How was it? My 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, that is.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, of course, the way she dashes by 
like a gust of wind is just so wonderful—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"On the other hand, did I look a bit like 
a villain in the paddock and winner's 
circle?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-Not at all, nothing like that...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I've heard that some people 
might get that impression. But still...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am not ashamed of my actions as being 
selfish; rather, I take pride in them 
being true to myself.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I certainly won't change the way I do 
things, even in the races I run alongside 
you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I will crush you with everything I have. 
Because to me, that is the ultimate 
respect I can show a challenger.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Acting true to myself means it must be 
something *I* can be proud of, not just 
"someone else".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...I must act in a way that I can be proud 
of, rather than seeking approval from 
others...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've given it some thought since then. 
About the difference between being true to 
oneself and being selfish, as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the past, I certainly acted 
selfishly in ways I'm ashamed of. But—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I don't want to be 
selfish; right now, I want to charge ahead 
true to myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, regarding next month's Fan 
Appreciation Festival... I would like to 
perform on this stage.

What Kawakami Princess showed me was a 
certain stage plan.

""Looking back on last year's Tiara route! 
A joint talk show featuring radiant 
Umamusume!""

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who competed together last 
year... and their fans will apparently be 
gathering as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to take the stage for such a 
reason would be unbefitting of a princess.

Her gaze was resolute, as if she had made 
up her mind about something.

Yet deep down, she was wavering. Trembling 
slightly, but rallying herself to grow 
stronger.
